evidence.rootCause: Four scaffold documentation contracts read an external OG skill package and AGENTS.md, both intentionally gitignored. npm test used &&, so their failure prevented the application suite from executing.

changes: Explicit skip reason only when the external package is absent; existing assertions are unchanged when present.
REQUIRE_WORKSPACE_DOCS=1 can require external contracts and fail on missing files.
Always run both repository and application suites; combine failures into a nonzero exit.
Make Repository and application tests a required GitHub integration gate.
Add three skip-policy and four test-runner regression cases.
nonChanges: No brand assets or actual brand-check/atomic-write behavior changed.
No application assertion removed, no secrets fetched, no external assistant instructions fabricated.
